issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents: The UML in problem_statement.md declares the method as getTotalNumberOfStudents(): String (problem_statement.md line 70), but the reference solution implements public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). The template only contains a TODO for this method (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 12) without a signature. This mismatch between the UML and the solution (and the natural numeric meaning of the operation) will confuse students about whether to implement a String-returning or int-returning method and may lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent and explicit. Update the UML in problem_statement.md (line 70) to '+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int' so it matches the solution. Also update the textual description that references the method (around lines 40-45) to state the method returns an int (total number of students). Optionally update the template TODO comment to mention the expected return type int to avoid ambiguity for students. Ensure any tests expect an int return value.
